answer.recommendation: Take the rail route as the primary option. Leave the Berlin arrival point by about 09:20 to reach the platform, board the 25-minute train, and arrive in Potsdam around 09:45-10:00. That leaves roughly 60-75 minutes before the 11:00 meeting as a transfer buffer. Keep the taxi (40 minutes) as the contingency: if the rail leg is disrupted, leave by 10:10 at the latest so the taxi still arrives before 11:00. Both routes are operating, so the rail option is the default.
quality_notes: Rail (25 min) is the primary route; taxi (40 min) is the fallback with a latest departure of about 10:10 to still meet 11:00.
The packet does not give station access or walking time in Berlin; the 20-minute allowance to reach the platform is an assumption and should be confirmed.
No colleague input was requested; the plan relies only on the work packet figures.
The baseline summary is reproduced unchanged from the work packet.
